rooms.name: Room 1
rooms.shortDesc: A serene mountain-facing sanctuary looking out onto misty forest peaks.
rooms.description: Room 1 offers panoramic views of the Western Ghats mountain range of Attappadi. Complete with handcrafted wooden furnishings, organic cotton textiles, and a private balcony to enjoy the fresh tropical Kerala breeze.
features: En-suite rain shower with spring water
Fresh complimentary banana chips and local tea

rooms.name: Room 2
rooms.shortDesc: Cozy and rustic clay-themed retreat designed for traditional relaxation.
rooms.description: Room 2 embraces natural earth elements and hand-crafted stone interiors. Featuring gorgeous custom wood decor, high-pitched ventilation, and windows that open straight to the native fruiting canopy.
features: Direct stepping-stone path access to the wild orchid grove
Handcrafted terracotta planters with native herbs
Comfortable window seat looking into the valley
Pure essential oil diffuser with ginger-grass

rooms.name: Room 3
rooms.shortDesc: Environmentally safe bamboo and wood cottage with panoramic canopy views.
rooms.description: Our highest sanctuary, Room 3 features sustainable bamboo work and sliding glass doors that completely merge the bedroom with the forest canopy. Highly private and surrounded by lush green foliage.
features: Sliding bamboo screens for natural shade
Private sunrise hammock under the trees
Stitch-framed skylight above the canopy of the forest
Daily freshly squeezed passion fruit juice

rooms.name: Room 4
rooms.shortDesc: Expansive plantation suite designed for family slow-living.
rooms.description: Our largest accommodation, Room 4 is a luxury bedroom featuring teak wood flooring and classic high ceilings. Outfitted with separate reading alcoves and direct access to the communal firepit and dining hall.
features: Premium spacious layout with wooden reading table
Double rain showers and organic spice bath-salts
Private terrace with views of the Jellippara mountain ridges
In-room local coffee selection cooked on brass pots
